required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:122–124, 278–291 and 322–330: claimIfCompeting tracks an admitted send only when an identical unconfirmed record already exists. The reverse ordering is unsafe. Reproduced with the production Harness/store/parser/DesktopClient: send text once and receive admission while its transcript update is delayed; send the same text again from the still-ready snapshot and lose both delivery responses; then publish only the first send's operator entry. The second attempt's Not confirmed record disappears and its composer text is cleared, although that entry establishes only the first attempt. Track earlier admitted sends whose entries have not been observed, or otherwise correlate deliveries authoritatively, so their delayed entries cannot settle later unknown attempts. Acceptance: add a production-interface regression for admitted-then-unknown identical sends with delayed observation, proving the first entry leaves the second attempt unresolved and recoverable across renders/remounts; separate evidence for the second attempt may settle it exactly once, and nothing is resent automatically. Retain the existing unknown-then-admitted and transcript-bound regressions.
